notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Just released version 1.1, the main thing to see are all the new customisation options for RubiA. There are also a bunch of bug fixes and a small rework of the buttplug.io integration with strokers.

RubiA customisation:
- Custom colours
- Toggle RubiA's penis
- Breast size slider
- New outfits

Misc
- RubiA's robot arms would stick to the ground properly
- Final chase cutscene can be skipped by pressing spacebar
- Attempt to fix a problem with movement where Sibyl would drift to one side
- Stroker integration rework. Better movement during orgasm. Slider in the menu to adjust the maximum stroker height.
